Summary_JP: この創作作品を執筆し、「第８界」を創造した存在。代理人には「扇小春」という襲名と、この襲名に類似した名前を名乗る者が存在するとされる－－尤も、この「第８界」内部の住民にとっては知る由もない。
Summary_EN: This is the entity that wrote this creation work and created '#REGION.8'. It is said that there are agents who bear the name 'Koharu Arch' and those who bear similar names to this name -- however, the residents inside '#REGION.8' have no way of knowing.
